Broadcom (AVGO) vs Microsoft (MSFT): on the same formula, their operating margins are 6.9 pts apart. What does that gap explain, and what doesn’t it?

Latest fiscal year, same formula
• Revenue — AVGO: $63.9B · MSFT: $331.8B
• Revenue growth — AVGO: +23.9% · MSFT: +17.8%
• Operating margin — AVGO: 39.9% · MSFT: 46.8%
• Net margin — AVGO: 36.2% · MSFT: 40.3%
• Free cash flow margin — AVGO: 42.1% · MSFT: 20.2%
• 4-year revenue growth (compound annual) — AVGO: 23.5% · MSFT: 13.7%

Different fiscal years: AVGO Nov 2, 2025 · MSFT Jun 30, 2026. The periods are not identical.
